# ZeroBox CTF Tracker (ctftracker.com)

> ZeroBox is a free, offline-first CTF and OSCP preparation tracker that runs in the browser. It tracks Hack The Box and TryHackMe machines on a Kanban board, ships a pentest methodology checklist, an OSCP cheatsheet with reverse shells, and an exam simulator for 7 tracks (OSCP, CPTS, CRTO, OSEP, CRTP, PNPT, OSWE). All data stays in the user's browser (LocalStorage and IndexedDB); there is no backend. Site: https://ctftracker.com/

This ZeroBox is a CTF and penetration-testing practice tracker, unrelated to other products named ZeroBox.

ZeroBox is an independent project and is not affiliated with Hack The Box, TryHackMe or OffSec.

## Catalog
Tracks 1,027 CTF machines.

## App
- [CTF tracker](https://ctftracker.com/tracker/): Kanban, table and grid board for HTB and THM machines
- [Methodology checklist](https://ctftracker.com/methodology/): eight-phase attack lifecycle with copyable commands
- [Cheatsheet](https://ctftracker.com/cheatsheets/): commands and a reverse shell generator with LHOST and LPORT filled in
- [Notes](https://ctftracker.com/notes/): Obsidian-style viewer for the user's own imported or written notes (ships no notes)
- [Exam simulator](https://ctftracker.com/exam/): timed practice for 7 exam tracks (OSCP, CPTS, CRTO, OSEP, CRTP, PNPT and OSWE)
- [Writeups](https://ctftracker.com/writeup/): Markdown writeup editor
- [Analytics](https://ctftracker.com/analytics/): skill radar and activity heatmap
- [Evidence vault](https://ctftracker.com/vault/): credentials, flags and hashes per target

## Static references (readable without the app)
- [Machines](https://ctftracker.com/machines/): directory of HTB and THM machines by platform, OS and difficulty, with writeups and attack paths for solved machines at /machines/<name>/
- [Reverse shells](https://ctftracker.com/revshells/): reverse, bind, MSFVenom, HoaxShell and TTY upgrade one-liners grouped by language
- [Methodology guide](https://ctftracker.com/methodology-guide/): the eight phases, each at /methodology/<phase>/
- [Cheatsheet library](https://ctftracker.com/cheatsheet-library/): topic pages at /cheatsheets/<topic>/ (recon, web, exploitation, Linux privesc, Active Directory, pivoting, file transfers)
- [Pentest methodology notes](https://ctftracker.com/pentest-notes/): short general methodology notes with commands, each at /pentest-notes/<topic>/

- [Techniques hub](https://ctftracker.com/techniques/): index of technique pages at /techniques/<topic>/ (Active Directory, Kerberos, SMB, SQL injection, LFI, Linux and Windows privilege escalation, pivoting, password cracking and more)

## Guides
- [OSCP exam scoring and time budget](https://ctftracker.com/oscp-exam-scoring-and-time-budget/): how OSCP points are scored and how to split the 24 hours
- [TJ Null list](https://ctftracker.com/tj-null-list/): the community list of OSCP-style practice machines
- [OSCP report template](https://ctftracker.com/oscp-report-template/): structure for an exam or lab report
- [HTB progress tracker](https://ctftracker.com/htb-progress-tracker/): how to track Hack The Box progress on a board
- [CPTS exam guide](https://ctftracker.com/cpts-exam-guide/): preparing for the HTB CPTS exam
- [OSCP-like machines](https://ctftracker.com/oscp-like-machines/): practice machines suited to OSCP preparation
- [CPTS-like machines](https://ctftracker.com/cpts-like-machines/): practice machines suited to CPTS preparation
- [CRTO-like machines](https://ctftracker.com/crto-like-machines/): practice machines suited to CRTO preparation
- [HTB Starting Point machines](https://ctftracker.com/htb-starting-point-machines/): the Starting Point machine list
